newsitem.title: UK: SkyePharma, Abbott in licence accord.
newsitem.headline: SkyePharma, Abbott in licence accord.

text.p: British-based drug discovery group SkyePharma Plc said on Monday that its Swiss unit Jago Pharma had agreed to license its Geomatrix technology to Abbott Laboratoties Inc.
The Geomatrix technology will enable Abbott to develop an improved oral formulation of its asthma drug Zileuton, which is currently in late-stage trials.
SkyePharma said its Geomatrix technology, which is used to develop controlled release of drugs, would allow Zileuton to be taken twice a day instead of four times a day in its current formulation.
Abbott would receive manufacturing rights and distribute the Geomatrix formulation fo Zileuton, SkyePharma said, while Jago would receive royalties on net sales of the product.

SkyePharma executive chairman and chief executive officer Ian Gowrie-Smith said the agreement with Abbott was the first of a number of licensing deals under negotiation and should indicate to investors and commentators "the profile of drugs we have in development."
Shares in SkyePharma were 3 pence higher at 86 1/2 in pre-market trading on Monday morning. London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
